subject: general
question:
Six letters J, T, E, X, I and O are written on different faces of a dice. Two positions of this dice are shown in the figures below. Find the letter on the face opposite to X.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/580dc085f01c0d2d4822c394174f4a7042624ba261c041571b7a1ef10ede609e.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/00212c5207688323f06799bba10ffafb8fa6d624b8cf4545e6f297fda9783cdb.png]
solution:
For find the opposite surface of 'X', we need to compare the common surface in the given dices,

So, From Dice 1 and Dice 2,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/eb12382483aa551aad5a2a87f47b9f25d8bd408687fd9081209a0fed402c507a.png] c

From both dices, J is common and on the same surface. So, all remaining surface will be opposite to each other.

E is opposite to I.

So, T will be opposite to X.

Hence, the correct answer is "T".
